'''Hellhound Alphas''' are monsters released with [[The Zamorakian Undercity]]. One of these is located with two [[Hellhound Hunter]]s and the miniboss [[Desha, Guardian of the Hounds]] in the northeastern edge of the undercity, near the entrance to the Avernic Prison. Neither the alpha nor the hunters can leave the small area where they are found, although Desha can.

Their attacks may inflict the [[Savage Wounds]] bleed.

==Trivia==
* The Hellhound Alpha used to possess the [[Strong guard (status)|Strong guard]] status, which made the players' attacks incapable of missing and made their [[Ability damage|damage]] dependent on their [[Hit chance|accuracy]]; this was effectively replaced by the damage potential system on [[4 March]] [[2024]].
